web/around#

Code that goes around endpoints with web/routing's Around (#77):

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

WebRoutes(
    Around(AccessLog(Stdout())),
    Get(path: "/notes", endpoint: notes.list),
    Scope("/admin", Around(BearerAuth(token: secret)), Get(path: "/stats", endpoint: admin.stats)),
)

Description#

Code that goes around endpoints with web/routing's Around (#77):

An application's own around-handler does web/routing's Surrounding.

Public API#

object AccessLog#

object AccessLog does Surrounding

One line on out per request: the client's address, the method and the target, the status and the time the rest of the chain took:

127.0.0.1 "GET /notes?limit=5" 200 0.412 ms

A request that fails with an error other than an Exception is written with status 500, and the error passes on.

AccessLog.AccessLog#

AccessLog(out is WritingText, clock is Timing = SystemClock())

Writes one line per request to out, with its status and time taken.

AccessLog.around#

async around(request is WebRequest, inner is async (WebRequest) is Responding) is Responding

Runs the endpoint and logs it.

object BearerAuth#

object BearerAuth does Surrounding

Lets a request through only with the token in Authorization: Bearer <token>; any other gets 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. The token is compared in constant time.

BearerAuth.BearerAuth#

BearerAuth(token is string)

Lets requests through only with Authorization: Bearer token; others get 401.

BearerAuth.around#

async around(request is WebRequest, inner is async (WebRequest) is Responding) is Responding

Checks the header, in constant time.

object Cors#

object Cors does WebRouting

Cross-origin requests from one origin, in one line of a table or a scope:

WebRoutes(Cors(origin: "https://app.example"), Resource("/notes", Get(notes.list), Post(notes.add)))

A preflight OPTIONS request below it is answered 204 with the method and the headers it asks for, before any Around (a browser sends no credentials then); a route of its own for OPTIONS on a path still wins. Replies to requests from the origin carry Access-Control-Allow-Origin. "*" allows every origin; credentials are not allowed.

object Compression#

object Compression does Surrounding

Replies compressed for clients that accept it (#186, #184): text, JSON, JavaScript, XML and SVG of at least minimum bytes (1 KiB unless told) that carry no Content-Encoding of their own:

WebRoutes(Around(Compression()), Get(path: "/notes", endpoint: notes.list))

Brotli (br, level 5) goes to a client that takes it at least as gladly as gzip, whatever order it lists them in; gzip to the others.

A reply in memory is compressed whole and keeps a Content-Length; a streamed one is compressed as it goes. A compressed reply says Vary: Accept-Encoding, its strong ETag becomes weak and it no longer offers ranges. HEAD, 204, 206 and 304 replies pass as they are.

Compression.Compression#

Compression(minimum is int = 1024)

Compresses replies of at least minimum bytes.
